A '''worklight''' was an illumination device used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" /> The items were readily available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and generally cost twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy.<ref name="SWS" />
